title: 补货清单
businessContext: 一家社区生鲜店每天开门前都要检查库存。采购同学希望先处理库存最紧张、同时仍在售的商品。

ddl: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL, reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

question: 找出仍在售且当前库存低于补货线的商品，返回商品名、库存和补货线，按库存从少到多排列。
requirements: 只统计 status 为 active 的商品
stock 必须小于 reorder_level
返回 name、stock、reorder_level 三列并按 stock 升序
hints: 筛选条件可以同时放在 WHERE 中
排序使用 ORDER BY
referenceSql: SELECT name, stock, reorder_level FROM products WHERE status = 'active' AND stock < reorder_level ORDER BY stock ASC
explanation: 先筛选在售商品，再比较库存与补货线，最后按库存升序，让最缺货的商品排在前面。
traps: 不要把等于补货线的商品算进去
不要包含已经下架的商品

title: 本周热帖
businessContext: 内容社区准备制作周报，需要挑出公开且互动活跃的帖子。运营只关注已正常发布的内容，草稿和删除内容都不应出现。

ddl: CREATE TABLE posts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, views INTEGER NOT NULL, likes INTEGER, visibility TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, published_at TEXT)

question: 选出公开且已发布、浏览量不少于 1000 的帖子，返回标题和浏览量，按浏览量从高到低取前 3 条。
requirements: visibility 为 public 且 status 为 published
views 不少于 1000
返回 title、views，按 views 降序并限制 3 行
hints: 不少于使用 >=
先排序再 LIMIT
referenceSql: SELECT title, views FROM posts WHERE visibility = 'public' AND status = 'published' AND views >= 1000 ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 3
explanation: WHERE 完成状态和浏览量筛选，ORDER BY DESC 把最高浏览量放在前面，再用 LIMIT 取前三条。
traps: 已删除的高浏览帖子不能计入
LIMIT 应放在 ORDER BY 之后

title: 站点延误率
businessContext: 物流区域经理要复盘各配送站点的服务质量。只有样本量足够的站点才进入本周整改清单。

ddl: CREATE TABLE deliveries (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, station TEXT NOT NULL, courier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, promised_at TEXT NOT NULL, delivered_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, distance_km REAL NOT NULL, fee REAL NOT NULL)

question: 按站点统计已送达订单数和延误订单数，延误定义为送达时间晚于承诺时间。只保留至少 3 个已送达订单的站点，按延误数从高到低排列。
requirements: 只统计 status 为 delivered
返回 station、delivery_count、late_count
至少 3 单，按 late_count 降序、station 升序
hints: 条件计数可以使用 SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
HAVING 用于筛选聚合后的分组
referenceSql: SELECT station, COUNT(*) AS delivery_count, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_at > promised_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count FROM deliveries WHERE status = 'delivered' GROUP BY station HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY late_count DESC, station ASC
explanation: 先排除未送达订单，再按站点聚合。COUNT 统计样本数，CASE 条件求和统计延误，HAVING 过滤小样本站点。
traps: 取消订单不能进入分母
延误条件是严格晚于承诺时间

title: 班级通过率
businessContext: 在线教育教研组需要查看各班最近一次测验的整体表现。样本过少的试学班不参与排名。

ddl: CREATE TABLE exam_scores (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, class_name TEXT NOT NULL, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, score REAL, submitted_at TEXT, attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, valid INTEGER NOT NULL, teacher_id INTEGER NOT NULL)

question: 统计每个班级有效成绩的学生数、平均分和通过率，60 分及以上算通过；只展示至少 3 名有效学生的班级，按通过率从高到低排列。
requirements: 只统计 valid = 1 且 score 非空的记录
通过率保留原始小数即可
返回 class_name、student_count、avg_score、pass_rate
hints: AVG 可以直接计算平均分
条件满足时计 1.0，再除以总人数
referenceSql: SELECT class_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count, AVG(score) AS avg_score, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pass_rate FROM exam_scores WHERE valid = 1 AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY class_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY pass_rate DESC, class_name ASC
explanation: 先过滤无效与缺考记录，按班级聚合。用条件求和得到通过人数，乘 1.0 避免整数除法，再按通过率排序。
traps: NULL 成绩不能进入人数和平均分
SQLite 整数相除会丢失小数

title: 高活跃客户
businessContext: SaaS 客户成功团队准备安排重点回访，希望识别付费状态正常且近期使用活跃的企业客户。

ddl: CREATE TABLE organizations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, plan TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, seats INTEGER NOT NULL, city TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE usage_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_name TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, duration_sec INTEGER, source TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id))

question: 找出 active 状态且在 2025 年 3 月至少有 3 次使用事件的企业，返回企业名、套餐和事件数，按事件数从高到低排列。
requirements: 企业 status 必须为 active
返回 name、plan、event_count
hints: 通过 organization_id 连接两张表
日期文本采用半开区间比较
referenceSql: SELECT o.name, o.plan, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count FROM organizations o JOIN usage_events e ON e.organization_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'active' AND e.occurred_at >= '2025-03-01' AND e.occurred_at < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY o.id, o.name, o.plan HAVING COUNT(e.id) >= 3 ORDER BY event_count DESC, o.name ASC
explanation: 先连接企业与使用事件，过滤企业状态和月份范围，再按企业聚合并用 HAVING 筛出高活跃客户。
traps: 欠费企业即使活跃也不能计入
日期上界使用下月 1 日更稳妥

title: 司机收入榜
businessContext: 网约车城市运营正在评选服务稳定的司机。只有完成单量达到门槛且没有被停用的司机才能进入候选名单。

ddl: CREATE TABLE drivers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, rating REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, joined_at TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_type TEXT NOT NULL, phone_tail TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE trips (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, driver_id INTEGER NOT NULL, rider_id INTEGER NOT NULL, fare REAL NOT NULL, platform_fee REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, ended_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (driver_id) REFERENCES drivers(id))

question: 统计成都 active 司机已完成行程的净收入（车费减平台费），只保留至少完成 2 单的司机，返回司机名、完成单数和净收入，按净收入降序排列。
requirements: 城市为成都且司机状态为 active
只统计 completed 行程
返回 name、trip_count、net_income
hints: 净收入是 SUM(fare - platform_fee)
司机条件在连接后过滤
referenceSql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(t.id) AS trip_count, SUM(t.fare - t.platform_fee) AS net_income FROM drivers d JOIN trips t ON t.driver_id = d.id WHERE d.city = '成都' AND d.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'completed' GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING COUNT(t.id) >= 2 ORDER BY net_income DESC, d.name ASC
explanation: 连接司机和行程后同时过滤司机与行程状态，按司机聚合完成单量和净收入，再筛掉单量不足者。
traps: 取消行程不能贡献收入
净收入需扣除平台费

title: 账户最新余额
businessContext: 数字银行风控团队要做日终核对，需要每个正常账户当天最后一笔流水后的余额。重复上报的时间点以流水编号较大者为准。

ddl: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_no TEXT NOT NULL, customer_name TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, opened_at TEXT NOT NULL, branch TEXT NOT NULL, risk_level TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE account_snapshots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, balance REAL NOT NULL, available_balance REAL NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, batch_no TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id))
seed: INSERT INTO accounts VALUES (1,'A1001','林舟','active','CNY','2023-01-01','上海','low'),(2,'A1002','周宁','active','CNY','2022-05-01','杭州','medium'),(3,'A1003','韩一','frozen','CNY','2024-03-01','北京','high')

question: 取每个 active 账户在 2025-03-01 当天最后一条快照；时间相同则取 id 最大的记录。返回账号、客户名、余额和记录时间，按账号升序。
requirements: 只处理 active 账户
每个账户仅保留一行，时间相同按 id 降序决胜
返回 account_no、customer_name、balance、recorded_at
hints: 可以先用 ROW_NUMBER 为每个账户编号
分区键是 account_id
referenceSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.recorded_at DESC, s.id DESC) AS rn FROM account_snapshots s WHERE s.recorded_at >= '2025-03-01' AND s.recorded_at < '2025-03-02') SELECT a.account_no, a.customer_name, r.balance, r.recorded_at FROM ranked r JOIN accounts a ON a.id = r.account_id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND a.status = 'active' ORDER BY a.account_no ASC
explanation: CTE 中按账户分区、时间和 id 倒序编号，rn=1 就是确定性的最后一条；再连接账户并过滤正常状态。
traps: 只用 MAX(recorded_at) 会在同一时间留下重复行
冻结账户不应出现在结果中

title: 创作者累计收益
businessContext: 视频平台创作者中心要展示月度收益走势和累计收益，方便签约作者判断内容经营的变化。退款应抵扣当月收益。

ddl: CREATE TABLE creators (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, nickname TEXT NOT NULL, tier TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, followers INTEGER NOT NULL, joined_at TEXT NOT NULL, manager_id INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE creator_earnings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, creator_id INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, earning_type TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, content_id INTEGER, settled INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES creators(id))

question: 统计 active 签约创作者 2025 年每月已结算净收益，并计算从年初到当月的累计收益。返回昵称、月份、月收益、累计收益，按昵称和月份升序。
requirements: 只统计 status=active、tier=signed 且 settled=1
月份格式为 YYYY-MM
退款金额按原值参与求和
hints: 先按创作者和月份聚合，再在聚合结果上使用窗口函数
strftime('%Y-%m', occurred_at) 可取月份
referenceSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT c.id, c.nickname, strftime('%Y-%m', e.occurred_at) AS month, SUM(e.amount) AS monthly_income FROM creators c JOIN creator_earnings e ON e.creator_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.tier = 'signed' AND e.settled = 1 AND e.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND e.occurred_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.nickname, month) SELECT nickname, month, monthly_income, SUM(monthly_income) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_income FROM monthly ORDER BY nickname ASC, month ASC
explanation: CTE 先把流水汇总到创作者月粒度，外层窗口函数再对月收益做累计，避免直接在明细上累计造成重复。
traps: 未结算流水不能计入
应先月汇总再做累计窗口

title: 新客支付漏斗
businessContext: 电商增长团队正在复盘新用户首周转化。事件会上报重复日志，因此同一用户同一步骤只能计算一次。

ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT NOT NULL, registered_at TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT, device TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, inviter_id INTEGER, experiment_group TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE user_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_name TEXT NOT NULL, event_time TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, page TEXT, order_id INTEGER, metadata TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id))
seed: INSERT INTO users VALUES (1,'organic','2025-03-01','上海','ios','active',NULL,'A'),(2,'ads','2025-03-01','杭州','android','active',NULL,'B'),(3,'organic','2025-03-02','北京','web','active',1,'A'),(4,'referral','2025-03-02',NULL,'ios','active',1,'B'),(5,'ads','2025-03-03','成都','android','blocked',NULL,'A')

question: 统计 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-07 注册的 active 用户首 7 天漏斗人数：浏览商品、浏览后加购、加购后支付。后一步必须发生在前一步之后；返回三个阶段名称和人数。
requirements: 每个用户每阶段只计一次
事件须发生在注册后 7 天内
后续阶段必须满足时间顺序
hints: 可先按用户求每类事件的最早时间
用 UNION ALL 输出三个阶段
referenceSql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT id, registered_at FROM users WHERE status = 'active' AND registered_at >= '2025-03-01' AND registered_at < '2025-03-08'), steps AS (SELECT c.id, MIN(CASE WHEN e.event_name='view_product' THEN e.event_time END) AS viewed_at, MIN(CASE WHEN e.event_name='add_cart' THEN e.event_time END) AS cart_at, MIN(CASE WHEN e.event_name='pay' THEN e.event_time END) AS paid_at FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN user_events e ON e.user_id=c.id AND e.event_time >= c.registered_at AND e.event_time < datetime(c.registered_at, '+7 days') GROUP BY c.id), valid AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN viewed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS viewed, CASE WHEN cart_at > viewed_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS carted, CASE WHEN paid_at > cart_at AND cart_at > viewed_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid FROM steps) SELECT 'viewed' AS stage, SUM(viewed) AS users FROM valid UNION ALL SELECT 'carted', SUM(carted) FROM valid UNION ALL SELECT 'paid', SUM(paid) FROM valid
explanation: 先圈定注册 cohort，再按用户压成各阶段最早时间。通过时间比较保证顺序，最后把三个阶段用 UNION ALL 纵向输出。
traps: 重复支付日志不能重复计数
有支付但没有加购的用户不能进入支付阶段

title: 连续活跃设备
businessContext: 物联网运维团队想发现连续稳定在线的门店设备，用于筛选固件灰度升级对象。同一天多次心跳只算一个活跃日。

ddl: CREATE TABLE devices (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, serial_no TEXT NOT NULL, store_name TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, installed_at TEXT NOT NULL, firmware TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE device_heartbeats (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL, signal INTEGER NOT NULL, battery INTEGER, firmware TEXT NOT NULL, ip TEXT, error_code TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id))

question: 找出 online 设备在 2025 年 3 月的最长连续活跃天数，同一天多次心跳只算一天。返回设备序列号、门店名和最长连续天数，按天数降序排列。
requirements: 只统计 status 为 online 的设备
先按设备和日期去重
返回 serial_no、store_name、longest_streak
hints: 连续日期减去 ROW_NUMBER 会得到同一组锚点
分组求长度后再取每台设备最大值
referenceSql: WITH active_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT device_id, date(heartbeat_at) AS day FROM device_heartbeats WHERE heartbeat_at >= '2025-03-01' AND heartbeat_at < '2025-04-01'), numbered AS (SELECT device_id, day, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY day) AS rn FROM active_days), islands AS (SELECT device_id, day, date(day, '-' || rn || ' days') AS grp FROM numbered), streaks AS (SELECT device_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak FROM islands GROUP BY device_id, grp), longest AS (SELECT device_id, MAX(streak) AS longest_streak FROM streaks GROUP BY device_id) SELECT d.serial_no, d.store_name, l.longest_streak FROM longest l JOIN devices d ON d.id=l.device_id WHERE d.status='online' ORDER BY l.longest_streak DESC, d.serial_no ASC
explanation: 先把心跳去重成活跃日；日期减去递增行号后，连续日期会落到同一个锚点。按锚点统计区间长度，再取每台设备最大值。
traps: 同一天多次心跳不能增加连续天数
设备中断一天后应开始新的区间
